curriculumVerificationNotes: The 2026-27 Class 8 NCERT English textbook is Poorvi, replacing the older Honeydew/It So Happened sequence for this catalogue.
The literature catalogue contains 15 texts across five units.
School-selected supplementary readers are not included because their exact title, publisher and edition are school-specific.
